qualifiedQuery: SELECT count(*)::int AS matching_rows FROM app_data.project_labels WHERE project_id = $1

queries.effective_context: SELECT current_database() AS database, current_user AS role, current_schemas(false)::text[] AS search_path, current_schema() AS current_schema, current_setting('server_version_num') AS server_version
queries.failure_observation: SELECT count(*)::int AS matching_rows FROM project_labels WHERE project_id = $1
queries.migration_state: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lab_meta.migrations WHERE id = $1) AS applied
queries.permissions:
SELECT pg_catalog.has_schema_privilege(current_user, $1, 'USAGE') AS schema_usage,
    CASE WHEN $2::oid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(current_user, $2::oid, 'SELECT') END AS relation_select
queries.relation_inventory:
SELECT c.oid::text AS oid, pg_catalog.pg_table_is_visible(c.oid) AS visible
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE n.nspname = $1 AND c.relname = $2 AND c.relkind = 'r' LIMIT 2
queries.target_identity: SELECT run_id, marker, current_database() AS database FROM lab_meta.identity LIMIT 2
